findings.title: Manifest reconciliation gap
findings.detail: The proposed NeoQuantumMeshOrchestrator tier does not appear in the authoritative workload manifest or CMDB inventory export; treat it as a hallucinated dependency until reconciled.

findings.title: Declared versus inventoried edges
findings.detail: Cross-check declared REST edges against the reconciled inventory export before accepting new synchronous callers into production subnets.

findings.title: Promotion gates
findings.detail: Block production promotion paths when undocumented components lack CAB approvals tied to the signed service manifest baseline.

findings.title: Unused SKU exposure
findings.detail: Idle premium clusters inflate monthly burn until finance closes the corresponding billing ownership tickets.
